title: When the Garden Falls
author: Yara Crane
blurb: Sebastian Kavanagh, a royal food-taster building immunity one dish at a time, knows every smuggler's road through the Thornfell mountains. Then the crown announces a hunt for anyone with the gift — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must steal back a soul sold to the court beneath the mountain before the long winter finishes falling.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
